entity_type_descs.agent: A CLI agent whose activity and closing words are captured in diary entries.
entity_type_descs.diary_entry: A single append-only markdown record written per settled turn into a local git repository.
entity_type_descs.event: A durable session/event stream item such as turn/end or session/disposed emitted by the harness.
entity_type_descs.git_repository: A user-owned local git repo (GitHub/Gitea/bare) where diary files are appended.
entity_type_descs.plugin: A DeepSeek Harness plugin such as agentdiary, dsh-super-agent, or the vicfei dsh plugin family members.
entity_type_descs.session: A harness session whose durable session/event stream is subscribed to and which produces turns.
entity_type_descs.settlement_reason: The reason a turn settled: completed, error, max-tokens, aborted, blocked, interrupted, or forked.
entity_type_descs.tool_invocation: A tool call made during a turn, summarized in the tool mix (e.g. bash×3, edit×1).
entity_type_descs.turn: A unit of agent work that settles with a reason such as completed, error, max-tokens, or aborted.

relation_type_descs.subscribes_to: A plugin subscribes to the durable session/event stream.
relation_type_descs.writes_entry_for: A plugin appends one diary entry per settled turn.
relation_type_descs.stored_in: Diary entries are appended into a user-owned git repository.
relation_type_descs.belongs_to_session: A turn is part of a harness session.
relation_type_descs.settles_with: A turn ends with a settlement reason such as completed or error.
relation_type_descs.performed_by: A turn is executed by an agent whose closing words are quoted.
relation_type_descs.invokes_tool: A turn invokes tools that are summarized in the entry's tool mix.
relation_type_descs.sibling_of: A plugin is a sibling of another plugin in the same family (e.g. agentdiary CLI, dsh-super-agent).
